# Darkrune

Darkrune is a dark theme with a neon palette of purple, magenta, violet and pink accented by lime green, a terminal-like feel, and display headings with a subtle glow. It adds colored syntax highlighting, callouts rendered as matte cards, and a graph view with an animated nebula and particles. Colors, glow and effects are adjusted in the panel at the top of theme.css.

![Darkrune screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/doritosuai/darkrune/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Darkrune"
    author: "doritosuai"
    repo:   "doritosuai/darkrune"
    slug:   "darkrune"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/darkrune"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/doritosuai/darkrune"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/doritosuai/darkrune/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Aplique um tema escuro com paleta neon roxa·magenta·violeta·rosa e detalhes em verde lima, com vibe de terminal e títulos de display com brilho sutil. Exiba realce de sintaxe colorido, callouts em cards foscos e grafo com nebulosa animada e partículas; ajuste cores, brilho e efeitos no painel superior do theme.css."
}
```
